people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
translations.bsb: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
translations.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
translations.asv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
